versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.

youtube-thumbnail-maker 0.2.2

- Tightened input requirements: now always require a topic or working title before proceeding to paid work, ensuring title and thumbnail are aligned.
- Clarified that the three proposed thumbnail directions must be structural prototypes (varying hero, crop, or curiosity gap), not just color variations.
- Improved guidance: at least one direction should sit on a same-track reference named by the user.
- When writing the paid confirmation card, now explicitly write the curiosity gap that complements the title.
- Documentation is updated for greater specificity in brief-building and more robust handling of required inputs.
- Removed deprecated file: skill-card.md.
Maintenance release. The English instructions and listing copy are unchanged.
